name: (01) Protean — 1 Basic — Eyes of the Beast

system.description:
An eerie red glow kindles in your eyes, and the absolute dark of night becomes as clear to you as a lit room.

Merely declare your intent; the change completes at the end of the turn and may be held at will. While it is active you suffer no penalties whatsoever for natural darkness. However, your glowing red eyes give you the Negative Trait Bestial unless you conceal them (most commonly with sunglasses), and openly using the power is a rather obvious breach of the Masquerade. Retest with Survival.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
